By these applications, the applicant is seeking quashing for quashing of the First Information Reports registered against him vide Crime Nos.422/2018, 532/2018, 254/2018 and 375/2018 at various police stations.
The applicant is the same in all these applications.

3. The applicant is arrayed as an accused in connection with crime No.422/2018 which was registered at Police Station Umarkhed District Yavatmal for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468, 471, 294, 506 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short, 'IPC') on the basis of report lodged by Inamullah Khan Karamatullah Khan.

Crime No.532/2018 was registered against present applicant registered at Police Station Mahagan District Yavatmal on the basis of report lodged by Sheikh Habib Abdul Majid Sheikh under Sections 420 and 471 of the IPC.

5. Crime No.254/2018 was registered against present applicant at Police Station Parwa District Yavatmal for the offences punishable under Section 420, 468, 471, 504, 506 read with 34 of the IPC by Yusuf Khan Akhbar Khan 6.

Crime No.375/2018 was registered against present applicant at Police Station Ner Parsopant,
District Yavatmal for the offences punishable under Sections 420 read 34 of the IPC by Imran Khan Usman Khan.
7. The allegations in all the FIRs are against present applicant and other co-accused are that they run business of Tour and Travels under the name and style as "Hamza Tours and Travels" at Digras.

They published a pamphlet regarding Hajj pilgrimage and collected the money from various persons, who are desired to go for Hajj pilgrimage and thereby cheated them by 4 apl 879.18.odt.+
connected..odt obtaining the money from them under the pretext of sending them to the said pilgrimage.
In Crime No.375/2018 the informant Imran Khan Usman Khan paid Rs.5,20,000/-.
In Crime No.254/2018 the complainant Yusuf Khan Akhbar Khan allegedly paid them the amount of Rs.5,00,000/-.

In Crime No.532/2018 the complainant Sheikh Habib Abdul Majid Sheikh allegedly paid them Rs.12,00,000/- and in Crime No.422/2018 the complainant Inamullah Khan Karamatullah Khan allegedly paid them an amount of Rs.5,00,000/-.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant.
He submitted that as far as present applicant is concerned, he is a lawyer by profession.
He has no concerned, with Hamza Hajj Tours and Travels as owner of the said Tours and Travels is his brother namely Mohd. Yamin Mohd. Yasid Kasid.
The statements of the witnesses nowhere disclose any inducement or any amount received by the present applicant.
He submitted that as far as present applicant is concerned, except he is brother of the owner of the said tours and travels, absolutely he has no concerned.
At the most, the intention can be attributed to other accused who is owner of the said Tours and Travels.
There are general and vague allegations against the present applicant.
In view of that, no prima-facie case is made out against the present applicant and therefore, all the FIRs deserve to be quashed and set aside against him.
10. Per contra, learned APP strongly opposed the said contention and submitted that there is an allegation against the present applicant as to inducement by him.
The shop licence is in name of other co-accused Mohd. Yamin Mohd. Yasin Kasid.

But the statements of the witnesses disclose that it was the present 4 apl 879.18.odt.+ connected..odt applicant who has induced them to pay the amount and thereby they paid the amount but no steps were taken to take them at Hajj Pilgrimage.
The cheques which are issued to the various witnesses are also by the co-accused.
The Investigating Officer has recorded the statements of the various persons which sufficiently show the prima-facie material against the present applicant.
In view of that, applications deserve to be rejected.

11. After hearing both the sides and on perusal of the entire investigation papers, admittedly the said Hamza Hajj and Umra Tours and Travels is in the name of co-accused Mohd. Yamin Mohd. Yasin Kasid.
The application for renewal of registration of the Maharashtra Shops and Establishment Act also shows the name of owner of the said Tours and Travels as Mohd. Yamin Mohd. Yasin Kasid.
The pamphlets or the brochure which are placed on record also shows that advertisement was made by the co-accused attracting the people for Hajj Pilgrimage.

The notification issued by the Ministry of Minority Affairs (Hajj Division) shows that said Hamza Tours and Travels is not the authorized Travel Company, to take the pilgrimage's for pilgrimage of Hajj.

As far as allegations regarding criminal intimidation is concerned, Section 504 of IPC contemplates intentionally insulting a person and thereby provoking such person insulted to breach of the peace or intentionally insulting the person knowing it to be likely that the person insulted may be provoked so as to cause a breach of the public peace, or to commit any other offence.
Mere abuse may not come within the purview of the said section.

But the words of abuse in a particular case might amount 4 apl 879.18.odt.+ connected..odt to have intentional insult provoking the person insulted to commit a breach of public peace or to commit any other offences 13.
Considering the allegations levelled against the present applicant admittedly, vague, general and omnibus allegations are levelled against him.
The allegations that present applicant has also obtained the money is not substantiated by any other material, except the general and omnibus allegations.
In fact the present applicant is neither the owner nor there is any document to show any connection of the present applicant with the said Hamza Tours and Travels.
It is apparent that merely because the applicant is the brother of the owner of the said Hamza Tours and Travels who is also one of the co-accused, he shown to be an accused.

14. As far as the inducement part is concerned, complainant is required to show that applicant had fraudulent dishonest intention at the time of making a promise or representation even in case where allegations are made in regard to failure on the part of the accused to keep his promises, in the absence of culpable intention at the time of making initial promise being absent no offence under Section 420 of the IPC can 4 apl
connected..odt be said to have been made out and that the real test is whether the allegations in the complaint disclose the criminal offence of cheating.
15. On a careful consideration of aforesaid facts and circumstances, I find that none of the offence alleged against the applicant here, is made out.
